core/tokens/starfield/params/camera.ts

Camera-rig and navigation parameters — field of view,
Source src/core/tokens/starfield/params/camera.ts
UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

NEAR

Near plane — the solar tier is drawn at honest stellar-neighbourhood scale (planets are ~0.001-unit specks), so the near plane must sit under the closest lawful approach (SF_ZOOM.MIN 0.02). The FAR/NEAR ratio of 2e7 is far beyond linear 24-bit depth precision, so the renderer runs a logarithmic depth buffer — see renderer-setup.

FAR

Far plane — reaches the cosmic tier and observable-universe boundary shell with logarithmic depth buffer precision.

HOME_X

Home/overview pose — frames the solar system tier out to Kuiper belt.

SF_MOTION

Fly-to tween + idle drift timing (ms / scene-units per second).

FLY_MS

Camera flight duration on body select — long enough to read as a glide.

DAMPING

Controls damping factor per frame (OrbitControls.enableDamping).

ORBIT_SPEED

Base orbit angular speed (rad/s) multiplied by each body's speed field.

SPIN_SPEED

Base self-rotation speed (rad/s) multiplied by each body's spin field.

SF_APPROACH

Lazy-dossier trigger distance — the JSON for a body prefetches when the camera comes within approachPad + body.radius * approachScale units, so big bodies arm their data earlier than small ones.

SF_ZOOM

Orbit-controls zoom bounds — clamps how far the camera can dolly: MIN keeps a close approach above the body surface; MAX frames the whole cosmic hierarchy — Milky Way, the Local Group neighbourhood and the supercluster/observable-universe shells.

MIN

Closest lawful camera–target distance above body surface.

STANDOFF

Fly-to standoff multiplier — the camera glides to STANDOFF × the body's radius along its current view direction.

STANDOFF_MIN

Fly-to standoff floor.

SF_TIP

Hover/hint tooltip projection — the navigator's position hint clamps the picked body's projected marker inside the canvas edge when the object sits off-screen or behind the camera, so hovering a catalog row locates it at any zoom level. EDGE_PAD is the canvas-space inset (px) that keeps the marker dot and its label readable on the frame edge.

SF_KEYS

Arrow-key view rotation — radians per keypress applied around the controls target; POLAR clamps keep the camera off the poles.
